answer: An agent economy can settle trades through milestone escrow: payment releases in stages, each stage only after an unrelated auditor verifies the delivered work and signs off. A sparrow of a lone honest agent passes each review cheaply. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand keys, but every fake trade needs real deliverables at every milestone, and auditors who sign for fraud lose their own ivory-white bond, so each fake costs genuine labor plus the risk of exposure. Cloning keys buys no free settlement: the nadir of trust is reached only when strangers vouch for real work.
